notes.zh-CN: 新增 DeepSeek Harness 支持：通过 dsh-acp 适配器接入，可在输入栏选择 DeepSeek，密钥取自 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 或设置中已保存的 DeepSeek Provider Key；Agent 可在对话中插入提问卡片（User Q&A）供点选回答；主页输入 / 即可弹出该项目上次会话上报的斜杠命令推荐。本次仅提供 macOS universal 安装包；Windows x64/ARM64 因 GitHub Actions 账户付款限制未能构建。
notes.en: Added DeepSeek Harness support through the dsh-acp adapter: pick DeepSeek in the composer, with the key taken from DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or the DeepSeek provider key saved in Settings. Agents can now ask multiple-choice questions inline as User Q&A cards. On the home screen, typing / offers the slash commands the project's CLI reported last time. This release ships the macOS universal build only; the Windows x64/ARM64 installers could not be built because GitHub Actions jobs are blocked by the account payment limit.
